name: cbre-il-toolkit
description: CBRE's Industrial & Logistics toolkit for Claude — branded decks, occupier briefs, outreach angles, property longlists, site-tour apps, warehouse-network maps, and on-brand writing, plus a UK I&L toolkit.

plugins.name: cbre-il-toolkit
plugins.description: The CBRE Industrial & Logistics toolkit for Claude. Build polished, on-brand PowerPoint decks, turn a folder of property materials into an interactive longlist dashboard, brief the team on a target company before a meeting with a traceable occupier brief, surface evidence-backed reasons to reach out to a target company now as a ranked outreach-angles sheet with ready-to-send email hooks, build a CBRE-branded interactive site-tour itinerary app for the field, map a company's warehouse and distribution network to an auditable Excel, and keep every word in the CBRE tone of voice.

plugins.name: uk-il-toolkit
plugins.description: The UK Industrial & Logistics toolkit for Claude. Build a client-ready I&L longlist from a Kato requirement — enriched with rents and specs from the broker emails, ending in a per-property dataset, a clean client Excel and a CBRE-branded HTML dashboard; turn a CBRE EverGreen export into one portable HTML file pairing a scroll storyline with an interactive portfolio dashboard; download every brochure PDF linked from a longlist spreadsheet as one clean zip, named after each property and validated; and turn a folder of expense receipts into a reconciled Expenses.xlsx and a page-stamped consolidated receipt PDF, then file the lines into PeopleSoft. Versioned and installed independently of the CBRE I&L Toolkit, so updating one never re-syncs the other.
